Regression set rules

  • Protect one concrete compatibility contract per case.
  • Use the group and case names as the complete claimed scope.
  • Do not infer unlisted security, loader, timing, or cleanup guarantees.
  • Treat the generated execution result—not this inventory—as pass/fail authority.
event-pubsub scope is specific.

That group directly tests compatibility with the installed event-pubsub dependency. It does not extend its five named cases into a general event-dispatch guarantee.
